integrity: Exact proof and code were checked; numerical mesh enumeration is not substituted for the arbitrary-dimensional theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only first (twofold) vertex midpoint averaging and standard Euclidean cross-polytopes are treated. Prior literature on finite parity-grid coverings could overlap; the midpoint-cardinality paper was not available in full text.
title: A sharp midpoint net and complete deep-hole classification for cross-polytopes
